```json
  ],
  "seen_merchants": [
    "string"
  ],
  "first_txn_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "last_txn_approved_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "last_cp_country": "string",
  "last_cp_postal_code": "string",
  "last_cp_timestamp": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "approved_txn_amount_m2": 0,
  "approved_txn_amount_m2_7d": 0,
  "approved_txn_amount_m2_30d": 0,
  "approved_txn_amount_m2_90d": 0,
  "three_ds_success_count": 0,
  "three_ds_total_count": 0
}
```

Behavioral feature state for a card or account derived from its transaction history.

Derived statistical features (averages, standard deviations, z-scores) are computed using Welford's online algorithm over approved transactions. Average fields are null when fewer than 5 approved transactions have been recorded. Standard deviation fields are null when fewer than 30 approved transactions have been recorded.

3DS fields (`three_ds_success_rate`, `three_ds_success_count`, `three_ds_total_count`) are card-scoped and will be null for account responses.

Raw fields (`seen_countries`, `seen_mccs`, `approved_txn_amount_m2`, etc.) are included so clients can compute their own transaction-specific derivations, such as checking whether a new transaction's country is in `seen_countries` to determine `is_new_country`, or computing a z-score using the raw mean and M2 values.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|avg_transaction_amount|number \| null|true|none|The average approved transaction amount over the entity's lifetime, in cents. Null if fewer than 5 approved transactions have been recorded.|
|stdev_transaction_amount|number \| null|true|none|The standard deviation of approved transaction amounts over the entity's lifetime, in cents. Null if fewer than 30 approved transactions have been recorded.|
|approved_txn_count|integer \| null|true|none|The total number of approved transactions over the entity's lifetime.|
|avg_transaction_amount_7d|number \| null|true|none|The average approved transaction amount over the last 7 days, in cents. Null if fewer than 5 approved transactions in window.|
|stdev_transaction_amount_7d|number \| null|true|none|The standard deviation of approved transaction amounts over the last 7 days, in cents. Null if fewer than 30 approved transactions in window.|
|approved_txn_count_7d|integer \| null|true|none|The number of approved transactions in the last 7 days.|
|avg_transaction_amount_30d|number \| null|true|none|The average approved transaction amount over the last 30 days, in cents. Null if fewer than 5 approved transactions in window.|
|stdev_transaction_amount_30d|number \| null|true|none|The standard deviation of approved transaction amounts over the last 30 days, in cents. Null if fewer than 30 approved transactions in window.|
|approved_txn_count_30d|integer \| null|true|none|The number of approved transactions in the last 30 days.|
|avg_transaction_amount_90d|number \| null|true|none|The average approved transaction amount over the last 90 days, in cents. Null if fewer than 5 approved transactions in window.|
|stdev_transaction_amount_90d|number \| null|true|none|The standard deviation of approved transaction amounts over the last 90 days, in cents. Null if fewer than 30 approved transactions in window.|
|approved_txn_count_90d|integer \| null|true|none|The number of approved transactions in the last 90 days.|
|is_first_transaction|boolean \| null|true|none|Whether the entity has no prior transaction history. Returns true if no history is found. Null if transaction history exists but a first transaction timestamp is unavailable.|
|time_since_last_transaction_days|number \| null|true|none|The number of days since the last approved transaction on the entity.|
|three_ds_success_rate|number \| null|true|none|The 3DS authentication success rate for the card, as a percentage from 0.0 to 100.0. Null for account responses.|
|distinct_country_count|integer \| null|true|none|The number of distinct merchant countries seen in the entity's transaction history.|
|distinct_mcc_count|integer \| null|true|none|The number of distinct MCCs seen in the entity's transaction history.|
|seen_countries|[string]|true|none|The set of merchant countries seen in the entity's transaction history. Clients can use this to determine whether a new transaction's country is novel (i.e. compute `is_new_country`).|
|seen_mccs|[string]|true|none|The set of MCCs seen in the entity's transaction history. Clients can use this to determine whether a new transaction's MCC is novel (i.e. compute `is_new_mcc`).|
|seen_merchants|[string]|true|none|The set of card acceptor IDs seen in the card's approved transaction history, capped at the 1000 most recently seen. Null for account responses. Clients can use this to determine whether a new transaction's merchant is novel (i.e. compute `is_new_merchant`).|
|first_txn_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The timestamp of the first approved transaction for the entity, in ISO 8601 format.|
|last_txn_approved_at|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The timestamp of the most recent approved transaction for the entity, in ISO 8601 format.|
|last_cp_country|string \| null|true|none|The merchant country of the last card-present transaction.|
|last_cp_postal_code|string \| null|true|none|The merchant postal code of the last card-present transaction.|
|last_cp_timestamp|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|The timestamp of the last card-present transaction, in ISO 8601 format.|
|approved_txn_amount_m2|number \| null|true|none|The Welford M2 accumulator for lifetime approved transaction amounts. Used together with `avg_transaction_amount` and `approved_txn_count` to compute the z-score of a new transaction amount (variance = M2 / (count - 1)).|
|approved_txn_amount_m2_7d|number \| null|true|none|The Welford M2 accumulator for approved transaction amounts over the last 7 days.|
|approved_txn_amount_m2_30d|number \| null|true|none|The Welford M2 accumulator for approved transaction amounts over the last 30 days.|
|approved_txn_amount_m2_90d|number \| null|true|none|The Welford M2 accumulator for approved transaction amounts over the last 90 days.|
|three_ds_success_count|integer \| null|true|none|The number of successful 3DS authentications for the card. Null for account responses.|

<h2 id="tocS_spend_limit_duration">spend_limit_duration</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaspend_limit_duration"></a>
<a id="schema_spend_limit_duration"></a>
<a id="tocSspend_limit_duration"></a>
<a id="tocsspend_limit_duration"></a>

```json
"ANNUALLY"
```

Spend limit duration values:

* `ANNUALLY` - Card will authorize transactions up to spend limit for the trailing year.
* `FOREVER` - Card will authorize only up to spend limit for the entire lifetime of the card.
* `MONTHLY` - Card will authorize transactions up to spend limit for the trailing month. To support recurring monthly payments, which can occur on different day every month, the time window we consider for monthly velocity starts 6 days after the current calendar date one month prior.
* `TRANSACTION` - Card will authorize multiple transactions if each individual transaction is under the spend limit.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier for the account to which the card belongs.|

This field is deprecated and will no longer be populated in the `Card` object. The key will be removed from the schema in a future release. Use the `/auth_rules` endpoints to fetch Auth Rule information instead.|
|card_program_token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier for the card program on which the card exists.|
|bulk_order_token|string \| null(uuid)|false|none|Globally unique identifier for the bulk order associated with this card. Only applicable to physical cards that are part of a bulk shipment|
|replacement_for|string \| null|false|none|If the card is a replacement for another card, the globally unique identifier for the card that was replaced.|
|cardholder_currency|string|false|none|3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code for the currency of the cardholder.|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|An RFC 3339 timestamp for when the card was created. UTC time zone.|
|digital_card_art_token|string \| null|false|none|Specifies the digital card art to be displayed in the user's digital wallet after tokenization. This artwork must be approved by Mastercard and configured by Lithic to use.|
|exp_month|string|false|none|Two digit (MM) expiry month.|
|exp_year|string|false|none|Four digit (yyyy) expiry year.|
|funding|null \| [funding_account](#schemafunding_account)|true|none|Deprecated: Funding account for the card.|
|hostname|string|false|none|Hostname of card's locked merchant (will be empty if not applicable).|
|last_four|string|true|none|Last four digits of the card number.|
|memo|string|false|none|Friendly name to identify the card.|
|network_program_token|string \| null|false|none|Globally unique identifier for the card's network program. Null if the card is not associated with a network program. Currently applicable to Visa cards participating in Account Level Management only|
|pending_commands|[string]|false|none|Indicates if there are offline PIN changes pending card interaction with an offline PIN terminal. Possible commands are: CHANGE_PIN, UNBLOCK_PIN. Applicable only to cards issued in markets supporting offline PINs.|
|pin_status|string|true|none|Indicates if a card is blocked due a PIN status issue (e.g. excessive incorrect attempts).|
|product_id|string \| null|false|none|Only applicable to cards of type `PHYSICAL`. This must be configured with Lithic before use. Specifies the configuration (i.e., physical card art) that the card should be manufactured with.|
|spend_limit|integer|true|none|Amount (in cents) to limit approved authorizations (e.g. 100000 would be a $1,000 limit). Transaction requests above the spend limit will be declined.|
|spend_limit_duration|[spend_limit_duration](#schemaspend_limit_duration)|true|none|Spend limit duration values:<br><br>* `ANNUALLY` - Card will authorize transactions up to spend limit for the trailing year.<br>* `FOREVER` - Card will authorize only up to spend limit for the entire lifetime of the card.<br>* `MONTHLY` - Card will authorize transactions up to spend limit for the trailing month. To support recurring monthly payments, which can occur on different day every month, the time window we consider for monthly velocity starts 6 days after the current calendar date one month prior.<br>* `TRANSACTION` - Card will authorize multiple transactions if each individual transaction is under the spend limit.|
|state|string|true|none|Card state values: * `CLOSED` - Card will no longer approve authorizations. Closing a card cannot be undone. * `OPEN` - Card will approve authorizations (if they match card and account parameters). * `PAUSED` - Card will decline authorizations, but can be resumed at a later time. * `PENDING_FULFILLMENT` - The initial state for cards of type `PHYSICAL`. The card is provisioned pending manufacturing and fulfillment. Cards in this state can accept authorizations for e-commerce purchases, but not for "Card Present" purchases where the physical card itself is present. * `PENDING_ACTIVATION` - At regular intervals, cards of type `PHYSICAL` in state `PENDING_FULFILLMENT` are sent to the card production warehouse and updated to state `PENDING_ACTIVATION`. Similar to `PENDING_FULFILLMENT`, cards in this state can be used for e-commerce transactions or can be added to mobile wallets. API clients should update the card's state to `OPEN` only after the cardholder confirms receipt of the card. In sandbox, the same daily batch fulfillment occurs, but no cards are actually manufactured.|
|substatus|string \| null|false|none|Card state substatus values: * `LOST` - The physical card is no longer in the cardholder's possession due to being lost or never received by the cardholder. * `COMPROMISED` - Card information has been exposed, potentially leading to unauthorized access. This may involve physical card theft, cloning, or online data breaches. * `DAMAGED` - The physical card is not functioning properly, such as having chip failures or a demagnetized magnetic stripe. * `END_USER_REQUEST` - The cardholder requested the closure of the card for reasons unrelated to fraud or damage, such as switching to a different product or closing the account. * `ISSUER_REQUEST` - The issuer closed the card for reasons unrelated to fraud or damage, such as account inactivity, product or policy changes, or technology upgrades. * `NOT_ACTIVE` - The card hasn’t had any transaction activity for a specified period, applicable to statuses like `PAUSED` or `CLOSED`. * `SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY` - The card has one or more suspicious transactions or activities that require review. This can involve prompting the cardholder to confirm legitimate use or report confirmed fraud. * `INTERNAL_REVIEW` - The card is temporarily paused pending further internal review. * `EXPIRED` - The card has expired and has been closed without being reissued. * `UNDELIVERABLE` - The card cannot be delivered to the cardholder and has been returned. * `OTHER` - The reason for the status does not fall into any of the above categories. A comment can be provided to specify the reason.|
|comment|string|false|none|Additional context or information related to the card.|
|tags|[tags](#schematags)|true|none|Key-value pairs for tagging resources. Tags allow you to associate arbitrary metadata with a resource for your own purposes. A resource can have at most 50 tags, with keys up to 40 characters and values up to 500 characters|
|token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier.|
|type|string|true|none|Card types: * `VIRTUAL` - Card will authorize at any merchant and can be added to a digital wallet like Apple Pay or Google Pay (if the card program is digital wallet-enabled). * `PHYSICAL` - Manufactured and sent to the cardholder. We offer white label branding, credit, ATM, PIN debit, chip/EMV, NFC and magstripe functionality. * `SINGLE_USE` - Card is closed upon first successful authorization. * `MERCHANT_LOCKED` - Card is locked to the first merchant that successfully authorizes the card. * `UNLOCKED` - *[Deprecated]* Similar behavior to VIRTUAL cards, please use VIRTUAL instead. * `DIGITAL_WALLET` - *[Deprecated]* Similar behavior to VIRTUAL cards, please use VIRTUAL instead.|

|pin_status|NOT_SET|

|substatus|EXPIRED|

|type|VIRTUAL|

|type|DIGITAL_WALLET|

|substatus|string \| null|false|none|Card state substatus values: * `LOST` - The physical card is no longer in the cardholder's possession due to being lost or never received by the cardholder. * `COMPROMISED` - Card information has been exposed, potentially leading to unauthorized access. This may involve physical card theft, cloning, or online data breaches. * `DAMAGED` - The physical card is not functioning properly, such as having chip failures or a demagnetized magnetic stripe. * `END_USER_REQUEST` - The cardholder requested the closure of the card for reasons unrelated to fraud or damage, such as switching to a different product or closing the account. * `ISSUER_REQUEST` - The issuer closed the card for reasons unrelated to fraud or damage, such as account inactivity, product or policy changes, or technology upgrades. * `NOT_ACTIVE` - The card hasn’t had any transaction activity for a specified period, applicable to statuses like `PAUSED` or `CLOSED`. * `SUSPICIOUS_ACTIVITY` - The card has one or more suspicious transactions or activities that require review. This can involve prompting the cardholder to confirm legitimate use or report confirmed fraud. * `INTERNAL_REVIEW` - The card is temporarily paused pending further internal review. * `EXPIRED` - The card has expired and has been closed without being reissued. * `UNDELIVERABLE` - The card cannot be delivered to the cardholder and has been returned. * `OTHER` - The reason for the status does not fall into any of the above categories. A comment can be provided to specify the reason.|
|comment|string|false|none|Additional context or information related to the card.|
|tags|[tags](#schematags)|true|none|Key-value pairs for tagging resources. Tags allow you to associate arbitrary metadata with a resource for your own purposes. A resource can have at most 50 tags, with keys up to 40 characters and values up to 500 characters|
|token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier.|
|type|string|true|none|Card types: * `VIRTUAL` - Card will authorize at any merchant and can be added to a digital wallet like Apple Pay or Google Pay (if the card program is digital wallet-enabled). * `PHYSICAL` - Manufactured and sent to the cardholder. We offer white label branding, credit, ATM, PIN debit, chip/EMV, NFC and magstripe functionality. * `SINGLE_USE` - Card is closed upon first successful authorization. * `MERCHANT_LOCKED` - Card is locked to the first merchant that successfully authorizes the card. * `UNLOCKED` - *[Deprecated]* Similar behavior to VIRTUAL cards, please use VIRTUAL instead. * `DIGITAL_WALLET` - *[Deprecated]* Similar behavior to VIRTUAL cards, please use VIRTUAL instead.|
|pan|string|false|none|Primary Account Number (PAN) (i.e. the card number). Customers must be PCI compliant to have PAN returned as a field in production. Please contact https://support.lithic.com/ for questions.|
|cvv|string|false|none|Three or four digit CVV printed on the card. Amex cards use four digit CVVs|

Dispute.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|amount|integer|true|none|Amount under dispute. May be different from the original transaction amount.|
|arbitration_date|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date dispute entered arbitration.|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of when first Dispute was reported.|
|customer_filed_date|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date that the dispute was filed by the customer making the dispute.|
|customer_note|string \| null|true|none|End customer description of the reason for the dispute.|
|network_claim_ids|[string] \| null|true|none|Unique identifiers for the dispute from the network.|
|network_filed_date|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date that the dispute was submitted to the network.|
|network_reason_code|string \| null|true|none|Network reason code used to file the dispute.|
|prearbitration_date|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date dispute entered pre-arbitration.|
|primary_claim_id|string \| null|true|none|Unique identifier for the dispute from the network. If there are multiple, this will be the first claim id set by the network|
|reason|string|true|none|Dispute reason:<br>* `ATM_CASH_MISDISPENSE`: ATM cash misdispense.<br>* `CANCELLED`: Transaction was cancelled by the customer.<br>* `DUPLICATED`: The transaction was a duplicate.<br>* `FRAUD_CARD_NOT_PRESENT`: Fraudulent transaction, card not present.<br>* `FRAUD_CARD_PRESENT`: Fraudulent transaction, card present.<br>* `FRAUD_OTHER`: Fraudulent transaction, other types such as questionable merchant activity.<br>* `GOODS_SERVICES_NOT_AS_DESCRIBED`: The goods or services were not as described.<br>* `GOODS_SERVICES_NOT_RECEIVED`: The goods or services were not received.<br>* `INCORRECT_AMOUNT`: The transaction amount was incorrect.<br>* `MISSING_AUTH`: The transaction was missing authorization.<br>* `OTHER`: Other reason.<br>* `PROCESSING_ERROR`: Processing error.<br>* `REFUND_NOT_PROCESSED`: The refund was not processed.<br>* `RECURRING_TRANSACTION_NOT_CANCELLED`: The recurring transaction was not cancelled.<br>|
|representment_date|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date the representment was received.|
|resolution_date|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date that the dispute was resolved.|
|resolution_note|string \| null|true|none|Note by Dispute team on the case resolution.|
|resolution_reason|string \| null|true|none|Reason for the dispute resolution:<br>* `CASE_LOST`: This case was lost at final arbitration.<br>* `NETWORK_REJECTED`: Network rejected.<br>* `NO_DISPUTE_RIGHTS_3DS`: No dispute rights, 3DS.<br>* `NO_DISPUTE_RIGHTS_BELOW_THRESHOLD`: No dispute rights, below threshold.<br>* `NO_DISPUTE_RIGHTS_CONTACTLESS`: No dispute rights, contactless.<br>* `NO_DISPUTE_RIGHTS_HYBRID`: No dispute rights, hybrid.<br>* `NO_DISPUTE_RIGHTS_MAX_CHARGEBACKS`: No dispute rights, max chargebacks.<br>* `NO_DISPUTE_RIGHTS_OTHER`: No dispute rights, other.<br>* `PAST_FILING_DATE`: Past filing date.<br>* `PREARBITRATION_REJECTED`: Prearbitration rejected.<br>* `PROCESSOR_REJECTED_OTHER`: Processor rejected, other.<br>* `REFUNDED`: Refunded.<br>* `REFUNDED_AFTER_CHARGEBACK`: Refunded after chargeback.<br>* `WITHDRAWN`: Withdrawn.<br>* `WON_ARBITRATION`: Won arbitration.<br>* `WON_FIRST_CHARGEBACK`: Won first chargeback.<br>* `WON_PREARBITRATION`: Won prearbitration.<br>|
|status|string|true|none|Status types:<br>* `NEW` - New dispute case is opened.<br>* `PENDING_CUSTOMER` - Lithic is waiting for customer to provide more information.<br>* `SUBMITTED` - Dispute is submitted to the card network.<br>* `REPRESENTMENT` - Case has entered second presentment.<br>* `PREARBITRATION` - Case has entered prearbitration.<br>* `ARBITRATION` - Case has entered arbitration.<br>* `CASE_WON` - Case was won and credit will be issued.<br>* `CASE_CLOSED` - Case was lost or withdrawn.<br>|
|token|string(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier.|
|transaction_token|string(uuid)|true|none|The transaction that is being disputed. A transaction can only be disputed once but may have multiple dispute cases.|

<h2 id="tocS_fraud-report-response">fraud-report-response</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemafraud-report-response"></a>
<a id="schema_fraud-report-response"></a>
<a id="tocSfraud-report-response"></a>
<a id="tocsfraud-report-response"></a>

```json
{
  "transaction_token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "fraud_status": "SUSPECTED_FRAUD",
  "fraud_type": "FIRST_PARTY_FRAUD",
  "comment": "string",
  "created_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "updated_at": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|transaction_token|string(uuid)|true|none|The universally unique identifier (UUID) associated with the transaction being reported.|
|fraud_status|string|true|none|The fraud status of the transaction, string (enum) supporting the following values:<br><br> - `SUSPECTED_FRAUD`: The transaction is suspected to be fraudulent, but this hasn’t been confirmed.<br> - `FRAUDULENT`: The transaction is confirmed to be fraudulent. A transaction may immediately be moved into this state, or be graduated into this state from the `SUSPECTED_FRAUD` state.<br> - `NOT_FRAUDULENT`: The transaction is (explicitly) marked as not fraudulent. A transaction may immediately be moved into this state, or be graduated into this state from the `SUSPECTED_FRAUD` state.<br> - `NO_REPORTED_FRAUD`: Indicates that no fraud report exists for the transaction. It is the default state for transactions that have not been analyzed or associated with any known fraudulent activity.|
|fraud_type|string \| null|false|none|Specifies the type or category of fraud that the transaction is suspected or confirmed to involve, string (enum) supporting the following values:<br><br> - `FIRST_PARTY_FRAUD`: First-party fraud occurs when a legitimate account or cardholder intentionally misuses financial services for personal gain. This includes actions such as disputing legitimate transactions to obtain a refund, abusing return policies, or defaulting on credit obligations without intent to repay.<br> - `ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER`: Account takeover fraud occurs when a fraudster gains unauthorized access to an existing account, modifies account settings, and carries out fraudulent transactions.<br> - `CARD_COMPROMISED`: Card compromised fraud occurs when a fraudster gains access to card details without taking over the account, such as through physical card theft, cloning, or online data breaches.<br> - `IDENTITY_THEFT`: Identity theft fraud occurs when a fraudster uses stolen personal information, such as Social Security numbers or addresses, to open accounts, apply for loans, or conduct financial transactions in someone's name.<br> - `CARDHOLDER_MANIPULATION`: This type of fraud occurs when a fraudster manipulates or coerces a legitimate cardholder into unauthorized transactions, often through social engineering tactics.|
|comment|string \| null|false|none|Provides additional context or details about the fraud report.|
|created_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|Timestamp representing when the fraud report was created.|
|updated_at|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|Timestamp representing the last update to the fraud report.|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|fraud_status|SUSPECTED_FRAUD|
|fraud_status|FRAUDULENT|
|fraud_status|NOT_FRAUDULENT|
|fraud_status|NO_REPORTED_FRAUD|
|fraud_type|FIRST_PARTY_FRAUD|
|fraud_type|ACCOUNT_TAKEOVER|
|fraud_type|CARD_COMPROMISED|
|fraud_type|IDENTITY_THEFT|
|fraud_type|CARDHOLDER_MANIPULATION|

<h2 id="tocS_event_type">event_type</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaevent_type"></a>
<a id="schema_event_type"></a>
<a id="tocSevent_type"></a>
<a id="tocsevent_type"></a>

```json
"account_holder_document.updated"
```

The type of event that occurred. Possible values:

- account_holder_document.updated: Occurs when an account holder's document upload status has been updated.
- account_holder.created: Occurs when a new account_holder is created.
- account_holder.updated: Occurs when an account_holder is updated.
- account_holder.verification: Occurs when an asynchronous account_holder's verification is completed.
- auth_rules.backtest_report.created: Auth Rules backtest report created.
- balance.updated: Financial Account Balance Update
- book_transfer_transaction.created: Occurs when a book transfer transaction is created.
- book_transfer_transaction.updated: Occurs when a book transfer transaction is updated.
- card_authorization.challenge: Occurs when an Out of Band challenge is issued during card authorization. The card program should issue its own challenge to the cardholder and then respond via [/v1/card_authorizations/{event_token}/challenge_response](https://docs.lithic.com/reference/respondtoauthorizationchallenge).
- card_authorization.challenge_response: Occurs when a cardholder responds to a challenge during card authorization.
- card_transaction.enhanced_data.created: Occurs when L2/L3 enhanced commercial data is processed for a transaction event.
- card_transaction.enhanced_data.updated: Occurs when L2/L3 enhanced commercial data is reprocessed for a transaction event.
- card_transaction.updated: Occurs when a card transaction happens.
- card.converted: Occurs when a card is converted from virtual to physical cards.
- card.created: Occurs when a new card is created.
- card.pin_updated: Occurs when a card's PIN is set, changed, unblocked, or blocked due to excessive incorrect PIN attempts.
- card.reissued: Occurs when a card is reissued.
- card.renewed: Occurs when a card is renewed.
- card.shipped: Occurs when a card is shipped.
- card.updated: Occurs when a card is updated.
- claim_document.accepted: Occurs when a claim document passes validation and is accepted.
- claim_document.rejected: Occurs when a claim document fails validation and is rejected.
- claim_document.uploaded: Occurs when a claim document is uploaded and begins validation.
- claim.created: Occurs when a dispute intake claim is created.
- claim.updated: Occurs when a dispute intake claim is updated, such as a status change or a change to its outstanding requirements.
- digital_wallet.tokenization_result: Occurs when a tokenization request succeeded or failed.

This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.result` instead.
- digital_wallet.tokenization_two_factor_authentication_code: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to the Lithic customer for self serve delivery.

This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code` instead.
- digital_wallet.tokenization_two_factor_authentication_code_sent: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to our downstream messaging providers for delivery.

This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code_sent` instead.
- digital_wallet.tokenization_updated: Occurs when a tokenization's status has changed.

This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.updated` instead.
- dispute_evidence.upload_failed: Occurs when an evidence upload fails for a dispute filed through the Chargebacks API (`/v1/disputes`).

This event is not emitted for Managed Disputes.
- dispute_transaction.created: Occurs when a new dispute transaction is created for a Managed Disputes case.
- dispute_transaction.updated: Occurs when a dispute transaction for a Managed Disputes case is updated.
- dispute.updated: Occurs when a dispute filed through the Chargebacks API (`/v1/disputes`) is created or updated.

This event is not emitted for Managed Disputes. Use `dispute_transaction.created` and `dispute_transaction.updated` instead.
- embed.session_generated: Occurs when a card embed session is successfully generated.
- embed.viewed: Occurs when a card detail is successfully revealed through an embed.
- external_bank_account.created: Occurs when an external bank account is created.
- external_bank_account.updated: Occurs when an external bank account is updated.
- external_payment.created: Occurs when an external payment is created.
- external_payment.updated: Occurs when an external payment is updated.
- financial_account.created: Occurs when a financial account is created.
- financial_account.updated: Occurs when a financial account is updated.
- funding_event.created: Occurs when a funding event is created.
- internal_transaction.created: Occurs when an internal adjustment is created.
- internal_transaction.updated: Occurs when an internal adjustment is updated.
- loan_tape.created: Occurs when a loan tape is created.
- loan_tape.updated: Occurs when a loan tape is updated.
- management_operation.created: Occurs when an management operation is created.
- management_operation.updated: Occurs when an management operation is updated.
- network_total.created: Occurs when a network total is created.
- network_total.updated: Occurs when a network total is updated.
- payment_transaction.created: Occurs when a payment transaction is created.
- payment_transaction.updated: Occurs when a payment transaction is updated.
- settlement_report.updated: Occurs when a settlement report is created or updated.
- statements.created: Occurs when a statement has been created.
- three_ds_authentication.challenge: The `three_ds_authentication.challenge` event. Upon receiving this request, the Card Program should issue its own challenge to the cardholder. After a cardholder challenge is successfully completed, the Card Program needs to respond back to Lithic by call to [/v1/three_ds_decisioning/challenge_response](https://docs.lithic.com/reference/postthreedschallengeresponse). Then the cardholder must navigate back to the merchant checkout flow to complete the transaction. Some merchants will include an `app_requestor_url` for app-based purchases; Lithic recommends triggering a redirect to that URL after the cardholder completes an app-based challenge.
- three_ds_authentication.created: Occurs when a 3DS authentication is created.
- three_ds_authentication.updated: Occurs when a 3DS authentication is updated (eg. challenge is completed).
- tokenization.approval_request: Occurs when a tokenization approval request is made.
- tokenization.result: Occurs when a tokenization request succeeded or failed.
- tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to the Lithic customer for self serve delivery.
- tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code_sent: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to our downstream messaging providers for delivery.
- tokenization.updated: Occurs when a tokenization's status has changed.

<h2 id="tocS_Event">Event</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemaevent"></a>
<a id="schema_Event"></a>
<a id="tocSevent"></a>
<a id="tocsevent"></a>

```json
{
  "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "event_type": "account_holder_document.updated",
  "payload": {},
  "token": "msg_1srOrx2ZWZBpBUvZwXKQmoEYga1"
}
```

A single event that affects the transaction state and lifecycle.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|An RFC 3339 timestamp for when the event was created. UTC time zone.<br><br>If no timezone is specified, UTC will be used.<br>|
|event_type|[event_type](#schemaevent_type)|true|none|The type of event that occurred. Possible values:<br><br>- account_holder_document.updated: Occurs when an account holder's document upload status has been updated.<br>- account_holder.created: Occurs when a new account_holder is created.<br>- account_holder.updated: Occurs when an account_holder is updated.<br>- account_holder.verification: Occurs when an asynchronous account_holder's verification is completed.<br>- auth_rules.backtest_report.created: Auth Rules backtest report created.<br>- balance.updated: Financial Account Balance Update<br>- book_transfer_transaction.created: Occurs when a book transfer transaction is created.<br>- book_transfer_transaction.updated: Occurs when a book transfer transaction is updated.<br>- card_authorization.challenge: Occurs when an Out of Band challenge is issued during card authorization. The card program should issue its own challenge to the cardholder and then respond via [/v1/card_authorizations/{event_token}/challenge_response](https://docs.lithic.com/reference/respondtoauthorizationchallenge).<br>- card_authorization.challenge_response: Occurs when a cardholder responds to a challenge during card authorization.<br>- card_transaction.enhanced_data.created: Occurs when L2/L3 enhanced commercial data is processed for a transaction event.<br>- card_transaction.enhanced_data.updated: Occurs when L2/L3 enhanced commercial data is reprocessed for a transaction event.<br>- card_transaction.updated: Occurs when a card transaction happens.<br>- card.converted: Occurs when a card is converted from virtual to physical cards.<br>- card.created: Occurs when a new card is created.<br>- card.pin_updated: Occurs when a card's PIN is set, changed, unblocked, or blocked due to excessive incorrect PIN attempts.<br>- card.reissued: Occurs when a card is reissued.<br>- card.renewed: Occurs when a card is renewed.<br>- card.shipped: Occurs when a card is shipped.<br>- card.updated: Occurs when a card is updated.<br>- claim_document.accepted: Occurs when a claim document passes validation and is accepted.<br>- claim_document.rejected: Occurs when a claim document fails validation and is rejected.<br>- claim_document.uploaded: Occurs when a claim document is uploaded and begins validation.<br>- claim.created: Occurs when a dispute intake claim is created.<br>- claim.updated: Occurs when a dispute intake claim is updated, such as a status change or a change to its outstanding requirements.<br>- digital_wallet.tokenization_result: Occurs when a tokenization request succeeded or failed.<br><br>This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.result` instead.<br>- digital_wallet.tokenization_two_factor_authentication_code: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to the Lithic customer for self serve delivery.<br><br>This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code` instead.<br>- digital_wallet.tokenization_two_factor_authentication_code_sent: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to our downstream messaging providers for delivery.<br><br>This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code_sent` instead.<br>- digital_wallet.tokenization_updated: Occurs when a tokenization's status has changed.<br><br>This event will be deprecated in the future. We recommend using `tokenization.updated` instead.<br>- dispute_evidence.upload_failed: Occurs when an evidence upload fails for a dispute filed through the Chargebacks API (`/v1/disputes`).<br><br>This event is not emitted for Managed Disputes.<br>- dispute_transaction.created: Occurs when a new dispute transaction is created for a Managed Disputes case.<br>- dispute_transaction.updated: Occurs when a dispute transaction for a Managed Disputes case is updated.<br>- dispute.updated: Occurs when a dispute filed through the Chargebacks API (`/v1/disputes`) is created or updated.<br><br>This event is not emitted for Managed Disputes. Use `dispute_transaction.created` and `dispute_transaction.updated` instead.<br>- embed.session_generated: Occurs when a card embed session is successfully generated.<br>- embed.viewed: Occurs when a card detail is successfully revealed through an embed.<br>- external_bank_account.created: Occurs when an external bank account is created.<br>- external_bank_account.updated: Occurs when an external bank account is updated.<br>- external_payment.created: Occurs when an external payment is created.<br>- external_payment.updated: Occurs when an external payment is updated.<br>- financial_account.created: Occurs when a financial account is created.<br>- financial_account.updated: Occurs when a financial account is updated.<br>- funding_event.created: Occurs when a funding event is created.<br>- internal_transaction.created: Occurs when an internal adjustment is created.<br>- internal_transaction.updated: Occurs when an internal adjustment is updated.<br>- loan_tape.created: Occurs when a loan tape is created.<br>- loan_tape.updated: Occurs when a loan tape is updated.<br>- management_operation.created: Occurs when an management operation is created.<br>- management_operation.updated: Occurs when an management operation is updated.<br>- network_total.created: Occurs when a network total is created.<br>- network_total.updated: Occurs when a network total is updated.<br>- payment_transaction.created: Occurs when a payment transaction is created.<br>- payment_transaction.updated: Occurs when a payment transaction is updated.<br>- settlement_report.updated: Occurs when a settlement report is created or updated.<br>- statements.created: Occurs when a statement has been created.<br>- three_ds_authentication.challenge: The `three_ds_authentication.challenge` event. Upon receiving this request, the Card Program should issue its own challenge to the cardholder. After a cardholder challenge is successfully completed, the Card Program needs to respond back to Lithic by call to [/v1/three_ds_decisioning/challenge_response](https://docs.lithic.com/reference/postthreedschallengeresponse). Then the cardholder must navigate back to the merchant checkout flow to complete the transaction. Some merchants will include an `app_requestor_url` for app-based purchases; Lithic recommends triggering a redirect to that URL after the cardholder completes an app-based challenge.<br>- three_ds_authentication.created: Occurs when a 3DS authentication is created.<br>- three_ds_authentication.updated: Occurs when a 3DS authentication is updated (eg. challenge is completed).<br>- tokenization.approval_request: Occurs when a tokenization approval request is made.<br>- tokenization.result: Occurs when a tokenization request succeeded or failed.<br>- tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to the Lithic customer for self serve delivery.<br>- tokenization.two_factor_authentication_code_sent: Occurs when a tokenization request 2FA code is sent to our downstream messaging providers for delivery.<br>- tokenization.updated: Occurs when a tokenization's status has changed.<br>|
|payload|object|true|none|none|
|token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier.|

<h2 id="tocS_hold_transaction">hold_transaction</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemahold_transaction"></a>
<a id="schema_hold_transaction"></a>
<a id="tocShold_transaction"></a>
<a id="tocshold_transaction"></a>

```json
{
  "token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "updated": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "family": "HOLD",
  "result": "APPROVED",
  "status": "PENDING",
  "financial_account_token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "pending_amount": 0,
  "currency": "string",
  "events": [
    {
      "token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "type": "HOLD_INITIATED",
      "result": "APPROVED",
      "detailed_results": [
        "APPROVED"
      ],
      "amount": 0,
      "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "memo": "string",
      "settling_transaction_token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08"
    }
  ],
  "user_defined_id": "string",
  "expiration_datetime": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

A hold transaction representing reserved funds on a financial account. Holds move funds from available to pending balance in anticipation of future payments. They can be resolved via settlement (linked to payment), manual release, or expiration.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token|string(uuid)|true|none|Unique identifier for the transaction|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|ISO 8601 timestamp of when the transaction was created|
|updated|string(date-time)|true|none|ISO 8601 timestamp of when the transaction was last updated|
|family|string|true|none|HOLD - Hold Transaction|
|result|[transaction_result](#schematransaction_result)|true|none|none|
|status|[hold_status](#schemahold_status)|true|none|Status of a hold transaction|
|financial_account_token|string(uuid)|true|none|none|
|pending_amount|integer|true|none|Current pending amount (0 when resolved)|
|currency|string|true|none|none|
|events|[[hold_event](#schemahold_event)]|true|none|none|
|user_defined_id|string \| null|true|none|none|
|expiration_datetime|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|When the hold will auto-expire if not resolved|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|result|APPROVED|
|result|DECLINED|
|status|PENDING|
|status|SETTLED|
|status|EXPIRED|
|status|VOIDED|

```json
  "payoff_period_monthly_payment_amount": 0,
  "payoff_period_payment_total": 0
}
```

Details on number and size of payments to pay off balance

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|minimum_payment_months|string|true|none|The number of months it would take to pay off the balance in full by only paying the minimum payment. "NA" will signal negative or zero amortization|
|minimum_payment_total|string|true|none|The sum of all interest and principal paid, in cents, when only paying minimum monthly payment. "NA" will signal negative or zero amortization|
|payoff_period_length_months|integer \| null|true|none|Number of months to full pay off|
|payoff_period_monthly_payment_amount|integer \| null|true|none|The amount needed to be paid, in cents, each month in order to pay off current balance in the payoff period|
|payoff_period_payment_total|integer \| null|true|none|The sum of all interest and principal paid, in cents, when paying off in the payoff period|

|financial_account_token|string(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier for a financial account|
|date|string(date)|true|none|Date of transactions that this loan tape covers|
|day_of_period|integer \| null|false|none|Day of the billing period that this loan tape covers, starting at 1|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of when the loan tape was created|
|updated|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of when the loan tape was updated|
|version|integer|true|none|Version number of the loan tape. This starts at 1|
|ytd_totals|[statement_totals](#schemastatement_totals)|true|none|none|
|period_totals|[statement_totals](#schemastatement_totals)|true|none|none|
|day_totals|[statement_totals](#schemastatement_totals)|true|none|none|
|balances|[balances](#schemabalances)|true|none|none|
|starting_balance|integer|true|none|Balance at the start of the day|
|ending_balance|integer|true|none|Balance at the end of the day|
|credit_limit|integer|true|none|For prepay accounts, this is the minimum prepay balance that must be maintained. For charge card accounts, this is the maximum credit balance extended by a lender|
|available_credit|integer|true|none|Amount of credit available to spend in cents|
|excess_credits|integer|true|none|Excess credits in the form of provisional credits, payments, or purchase refunds. If positive, the account is in net credit state with no outstanding balances. An overpayment could land an account in this state|
|account_standing|[account_standing](#schemaaccount_standing)|true|none|none|
|credit_product_token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier for a credit product|
|tier|string \| null|false|none|Interest tier to which this account belongs to|
|payment_allocation|[payment_allocation](#schemapayment_allocation)|true|none|none|
|payment_only_allocation|null \| [payment_allocation](#schemapayment_allocation)|true|none|Allocation of payments only, excluding credits|
|minimum_payment_balance|[balance_details](#schemabalance_details)|true|none|none|
|previous_statement_balance|[balance_details](#schemabalance_details)|true|none|none|
|interest_details|null \| [interest_details](#schemainterest_details)|true|none|none|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|installment_num|integer|true|none|Position of this installment within the plan, starting at 0|
|due_date|string(date)|true|none|Date the installment is scheduled to be assessed onto the account|
|payment_due_date|string(date)|true|none|Date the installment must be paid by before it is considered past due|
|date_assessed|string \| null(date)|true|none|Date the installment was actually assessed onto the account, or null if it has not been assessed yet|
|amount_due|integer|true|none|Amount the installment was opened for in cents|
|amount_due_details|[transaction_category_balances](#schematransaction_category_balances)|true|none|none|
|amount_paid|integer|true|none|Amount paid towards the installment in cents|
|amount_paid_details|[transaction_category_balances](#schematransaction_category_balances)|true|none|none|
|amount_outstanding|integer|true|none|Amount still owed on the installment in cents|
|amount_outstanding_details|[transaction_category_balances](#schematransaction_category_balances)|true|none|none|

|fee_amount|integer|true|none|Enrollment fee charged when the plan was created in cents|
|installment_plan_total|integer|true|none|Total owed on the plan in cents, the principal amount plus the enrollment fee|
|total_paid|integer|true|none|Amount paid towards the plan to date in cents|
|installments_paid|integer|true|none|Number of installments that have been paid off|
|installments_outstanding|integer|true|none|Number of installments that still carry a balance|
|state|[installment_plan_state](#schemainstallment_plan_state)|true|none|State of the installment plan. A plan is REBUILD_IN_PROGRESS while its loan tapes are being rebuilt, during which its payment totals are being recomputed and should not be treated as final|
|start_date|string(date)|true|none|Date the plan was created|
|closed_at|string \| null(date)|true|none|Date the plan was paid off or cancelled, or null while it is still open|
|source_type|[installment_plan_source](#schemainstallment_plan_source)|true|none|none|
|source_id|string|true|none|Identifier of the record the plan was opened from, such as the closing statement for an unpaid balance|
|source_amounts|null \| [transaction_category_balances](#schematransaction_category_balances)|true|none|Balance the plan was opened on, broken out by category, or null if it was not recorded|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of when the installment plan was created|
|updated|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of when the installment plan was updated|
|installments|[[installment](#schemainstallment)]|true|none|Installments that make up the plan, oldest first|
|installment_plan_adjustment|integer|true|none|Amount credited to this plan after the plan was recalculated. The plan amount is not changed, and this credit reduces the amount owed|

|source_type|TRANSACTION|

An immutable snapshot of an installment plan as of the statement it is attached to. Lithic cuts one per open plan when a statement is generated and never reissues it

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier for this snapshot, which is the token of the statement it is attached to. A plan is snapshotted at most once per statement, so the statement identifies the snapshot within the plan. Pass it as a pagination cursor|
|installment_plan_token|string|true|none|Globally unique identifier for the installment plan this snapshot is of|
|num_installments|integer|true|none|Number of installments the plan is broken into|
|principal_amount|integer|true|none|Balance the plan was opened on in cents, excluding the enrollment fee|
|fee_amount|integer|true|none|Enrollment fee charged when the plan was created in cents|
|installment_plan_total|integer|true|none|Total owed on the plan in cents, the principal amount plus the enrollment fee|
|total_paid|integer|true|none|Amount paid towards the plan as of this statement in cents|
|installments_paid|integer|true|none|Number of installments that had been paid off as of this statement|
|installments_outstanding|integer|true|none|Number of installments that still carried a balance as of this statement|
|state|[installment_plan_state](#schemainstallment_plan_state)|true|none|State of the installment plan. A plan is REBUILD_IN_PROGRESS while its loan tapes are being rebuilt, during which its payment totals are being recomputed and should not be treated as final|
|start_date|string(date)|true|none|Date the plan was created|
|closed_at|string \| null(date)|true|none|Date the plan was paid off or cancelled, or null if it was still open as of this statement|
|source_type|[installment_plan_source](#schemainstallment_plan_source)|true|none|none|
|source_id|string|true|none|Identifier of the record the plan was opened from, such as the closing statement for an unpaid balance|
|source_amounts|null \| [transaction_category_balances](#schematransaction_category_balances)|true|none|Balance the plan was opened on, broken out by category, or null if it was not recorded|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of when the installment plan was created|
|updated|string(date-time)|true|none|Timestamp of when the installment plan was last updated as of this statement|
|installments|[[installment_plan_statement_installment](#schemainstallment_plan_statement_installment)]|true|none|Installments that make up the plan, oldest first|
|installment_plan_adjustment|integer|true|none|Amount credited to this plan after the plan was recalculated, as of this statement. The plan amount is not changed, and this credit reduces the amount owed|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|state|PENDING|
|state|ACTIVE|
|state|REBUILD_IN_PROGRESS|
|state|FULLY_PAID|
|state|CANCELLED|
|source_type|UNPAID_BALANCE|
|source_type|TRANSACTION|

```json
    "banknet_reference_number": "string",
    "switch_serial_number": "string",
    "original_banknet_reference_number": "string",
    "original_switch_serial_number": "string"
  },
  "visa": {
    "transaction_id": "string",
    "original_transaction_id": "string"
  }
}
```

Information provided by the card network in each event. This includes common identifiers shared between you, Lithic, the card network and in some cases the acquirer. These identifiers often link together events within the same transaction lifecycle and can be used to locate a particular transaction, such as during processing of disputes. Not all fields are available in all events, and the presence of these fields is dependent on the card network and the event type. If the field is populated by the network, we will pass it through as is unless otherwise specified. Please consult the official network documentation for more details about these fields and how to use them.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acquirer|object|true|none|none|
|amex|object|true|none|none|
|mastercard|object|true|none|none|
|visa|object|true|none|none|
|*oneOf*|null|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|object|false|none|none|

|mcc|string|true|none|Merchant category code (MCC). A four-digit number listed in ISO 18245. An MCC is used to classify a business by the types of goods or services it provides.|
|state|string|true|none|Geographic state of card acceptor.|

<h2 id="tocS_network_risk_score">network_risk_score</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemanetwork_risk_score"></a>
<a id="schema_network_risk_score"></a>
<a id="tocSnetwork_risk_score"></a>
<a id="tocsnetwork_risk_score"></a>

```json
0
```

Network-provided score assessing risk level associated with a given authorization. Scores are on a range of 0-999, with 0 representing the lowest risk and 999 representing the highest risk. For Visa transactions, where the raw score has a range of 0-99, Lithic will normalize the score by multiplying the raw score by 10x.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|attended|boolean|true|none|True if a clerk is present at the sale.|
|card_retention_capable|boolean|true|none|True if the terminal is capable of retaining the card.|
|on_premise|boolean|true|none|True if the sale was made at the place of business (vs. mobile).|
|operator|string|true|none|The person that is designated to swipe the card|
|partial_approval_capable|boolean|true|none|True if the terminal is capable of partial approval. Partial approval is when part of a transaction is approved and another payment must be used for the remainder. Example scenario: A $40 transaction is attempted on a prepaid card with a $25 balance. |Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|acquirer_fee|integer \| null|true|none|Fee assessed by the merchant and paid for by the cardholder in the smallest unit of the currency. Will be zero if no fee is assessed. Rebates may be transmitted as a negative value to indicate credited fees.|

This field has been deprecated in favor of the `acquirer_reference_number` that resides in the event-level `network_info`.|
|account_token|string(uuid)|true|none|The token for the account associated with this transaction.|

|avs|null \| [avs](#schemaavs)|true|none|none|

|merchant_amount|integer \| null|true|none|**Deprecated.** Analogous to the 'amount', but in the merchant currency.|

|merchant_currency|[merchant_currency](#schemamerchant_currency)|true|none|**Deprecated.** 3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code for the local currency of the transaction.|
|network|string \| null|true|none|Card network of the authorization. Value is `UNKNOWN` when Lithic cannot determine the network code from the upstream provider.|
|network_risk_score|[network_risk_score](#schemanetwork_risk_score)|true|none|Network-provided score assessing risk level associated with a given authorization. Scores are on a range of 0-999, with 0 representing the lowest risk and 999 representing the highest risk. For Visa transactions, where the raw score has a range of 0-99, Lithic will normalize the score by multiplying the raw score by 10x.|

<h2 id="tocS_payment_event_type">payment_event_type</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemapayment_event_type"></a>

```json
"ACH_ORIGINATION_CANCELLED"
```

Note: Inbound wire transfers are coming soon (availability varies by partner bank). Wire-related event types below are a preview. To learn more, contact your customer success manager.

Event types:

ACH events:
* `ACH_ORIGINATION_INITIATED` - ACH origination received and pending approval/release from an ACH hold.
* `ACH_ORIGINATION_REVIEWED` - ACH origination has completed the review process.
* `ACH_ORIGINATION_CANCELLED` - ACH origination has been cancelled.
* `ACH_ORIGINATION_PROCESSED` - ACH origination has been processed and sent to the Federal Reserve.
* `ACH_ORIGINATION_SETTLED` - ACH origination has settled.
* `ACH_ORIGINATION_RELEASED` - ACH origination released from pending to available balance.
* `ACH_ORIGINATION_REJECTED` - ACH origination was rejected and not sent to the Federal Reserve.
* `ACH_RECEIPT_PROCESSED` - ACH receipt pending release from an ACH holder.
* `ACH_RECEIPT_SETTLED` - ACH receipt funds have settled.
* `ACH_RECEIPT_RELEASED` - ACH receipt released from pending to available balance.
* `ACH_RECEIPT_RELEASED_EARLY` - ACH receipt released early from pending to available balance.
* `ACH_RETURN_INITIATED` - ACH initiated return for an ACH receipt.
* `ACH_RETURN_PROCESSED` - ACH receipt returned by the Receiving Depository Financial Institution.
* `ACH_RETURN_SETTLED` - ACH return settled by the Receiving Depository Financial Institution.
* `ACH_RETURN_REJECTED` - ACH return was rejected by the Receiving Depository Financial Institution.

Wire transfer events:
* `WIRE_TRANSFER_INBOUND_RECEIVED` - Inbound wire transfer received from the Federal Reserve and pending release to available balance.
* `WIRE_TRANSFER_INBOUND_SETTLED` - Inbound wire transfer funds released from pending to available balance.
* `WIRE_TRANSFER_INBOUND_BLOCKED` - Inbound wire transfer blocked and funds frozen for regulatory review.

Wire return events:
* `WIRE_RETURN_OUTBOUND_INITIATED` - Outbound wire return initiated to return funds from an inbound wire transfer.
* `WIRE_RETURN_OUTBOUND_SENT` - Outbound wire return sent to the Federal Reserve and pending acceptance.
* `WIRE_RETURN_OUTBOUND_SETTLED` - Outbound wire return accepted by the Federal Reserve and funds returned to sender.
* `WIRE_RETURN_OUTBOUND_REJECTED` - Outbound wire return rejected by the Federal Reserve.

Stablecoin events:
* `STABLECOIN_RECEIVED` - Stablecoin pay-in received on-chain and pending release to available balance.
* `STABLECOIN_INITIATED` - Stablecoin withdrawal initiated, with the funds placed on hold.
* `STABLECOIN_REVIEWED` - Stablecoin pay-in or withdrawal has completed the review process.
* `STABLECOIN_SENT` - Stablecoin withdrawal accepted for on-chain submission to the destination address, and pending confirmation.
* `STABLECOIN_SETTLED` - Stablecoin pay-in funds released to available balance, or stablecoin withdrawal confirmed on-chain.
* `STABLECOIN_REJECTED` - Stablecoin withdrawal failed and the hold placed at initiation has been reversed.

<!-- backwards compatibility -->

<a id="tocsbase-transaction-response"></a>

```json
{
  "token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "updated": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "status": "PENDING",
  "family": "INTERNAL",
  "category": "ACH",
  "result": "APPROVED",
  "currency": "USD",
  "settled_amount": 200,
  "pending_amount": 500,
  "events": [
    {
      "amount": 0,
      "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
      "result": "APPROVED",
      "token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
      "type": "ACH_ORIGINATION_CANCELLED"
    }
  ],
  "descriptor": "string",
  "financial_account_token": "0cc87075-57cf-4607-8722-f42e2cb2c0cd"
}
```

Response containing multiple transaction types. The `family` field determines which transaction type is returned: INTERNAL returns FinancialTransaction, TRANSFER returns BookTransferTransaction, CARD returns CardTransaction, PAYMENT returns PaymentTransaction, EXTERNAL_PAYMENT returns ExternalPaymentResponse, MANAGEMENT_OPERATION returns ManagementOperationTransaction, and HOLD returns HoldTransaction

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|*oneOf*|[financial-transaction](#schemafinancial-transaction)|false|none|Financial transaction with inheritance from unified base transaction|
|*oneOf*|[book-transfer-transaction](#schemabook-transfer-transaction)|false|none|Book transfer transaction|
|*oneOf*|[card-transaction2](#schemacard-transaction2)|false|none|Card transaction with ledger base properties|
|*oneOf*|[payment-transaction](#schemapayment-transaction)|false|none|Payment transaction|
|*oneOf*|[external_payment_response](#schemaexternal_payment_response)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[management_operation_transaction](#schemamanagement_operation_transaction)|false|none|none|
|*oneOf*|[hold_transaction](#schemahold_transaction)|false|none|A hold transaction representing reserved funds on a financial account. Holds move funds from available to pending balance in anticipation of future payments. They can be resolved via settlement (linked to payment), manual release, or expiration.|

Request to return an ACH payment

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|financial_account_token|string(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier for the financial account|
|return_reason_code|string|true|none|ACH return reason code indicating the reason for returning the payment. Supported codes include R01-R53 and R80-R85. For a complete list of return codes and their meanings, see [ACH Return Reasons](https://docs.lithic.com/docs/ach-overview#ach-return-reasons)|
|memo|string \| null|false|none|Optional memo for the return. Limited to 10 characters|
|addenda|string \| null|false|none|Optional additional information about the return. Limited to 44 characters|
|date_of_death|string \| null(date)|false|none|Date of death in YYYY-MM-DD format. Required when using return codes **R14** (representative payee deceased) or **R15** (beneficiary or account holder deceased)|

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_token|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier denoting the account that the associated transaction occurred on.|
|card_program_token|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier denoting the card program that the associated transaction occurred on.|
|card_token|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier denoting the card that the associated transaction occurred on.|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|Date and time when the transaction first occurred. UTC time zone.|
|currency|string|true|none|Three-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code.|
|disputes_gross_amount|integer|true|none|The total gross amount of disputes settlements.|
|event_tokens|[string]|true|none|Array of globally unique identifiers for the financial events that comprise this settlement. Use these tokens to access detailed event-level information.|
|fee_description|string|false|none|Network's description of a fee, only present on records with type `FEE`.|
|institution|string|true|none|The most granular ID the network settles with (e.g., ICA for Mastercard, FTSRE for Visa).|
|interchange_fee_extended_precision|integer|true|none|The total amount of interchange in six-digit extended precision.|
|interchange_gross_amount|integer|true|none|The total amount of interchange.|

|other_fees_details|object|true|none|The total gross amount of other fees by type.|

|report_date|string|true|none|Date of when the report was first generated.|
|settlement_date|string|true|none|Date of when money movement is triggered for the transaction. One exception applies - for Mastercard dual message settlement, this is the settlement advisement date, which is distinct from the date of money movement.|
|token|string(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier denoting the Settlement Detail.|
|transaction_token|string \| null(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier denoting the associated transaction. For settlement records with type `CLEARING`, `FINANCIAL`, or `NON_FINANCIAL`, this references a card transaction token. For settlement records with type `CHARGEBACK`, `REPRESENTMENT`, `PREARBITRATION`, `ARBITRATION`, or `COLLABORATION`, this references the dispute transaction token. May be null for certain settlement types.|
|transactions_gross_amount|integer|true|none|The total amount of settlement impacting transactions (excluding interchange, fees, and disputes).|
|type|string|true|none|The type of settlement record.|
|updated|string(date-time)|true|none|Date and time when the transaction first occurred. UTC time zone.|

Represents a 3DS authentication

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|account_type|string \| null|true|none|Type of account/card that is being used for the transaction. Maps to EMV 3DS field `acctType`.|
|additional_data|object \| null|false|none|Object containing additional data about the 3DS request that is beyond the EMV 3DS standard spec (e.g., specific fields that only certain card networks send but are not required across all 3DS requests).|
|app|object \| null|false|none|Object containing data about the app used in the e-commerce transaction. Present if the channel is 'APP_BASED'.|
|authentication_request_type|string \| null|false|none|Type of authentication request - i.e., the type of transaction or interaction is causing the merchant to request an authentication. Maps to EMV 3DS field `threeDSRequestorAuthenticationInd`.|
|authentication_result|string|true|none|Indicates the outcome of the 3DS authentication process.|
|browser|object \| null|false|none|Object containing data about the browser used in the e-commerce transaction. Present if the channel is 'BROWSER'.|
|card_expiry_check|string|true|none|Indicates whether the expiration date provided by the cardholder during checkout matches Lithic's record of the card's expiration date.|
|card_token|string(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier for the card on which the 3DS authentication has occurred. Permitted values: 36-digit version 4 UUID (including hyphens).|
|cardholder|object|true|none|Object containing data about the cardholder provided during the transaction.|
|challenge_metadata|object \| null|false|none|Metadata about the challenge method and delivery. Only present when a challenge is triggered.|
|challenge_orchestrated_by|string \| null|false|none|Entity that orchestrates the challenge. This won't be set for authentications for which a decision has not yet been made (e.g. in-flight customer decisioning request).|
|channel|string|true|none|Channel in which the authentication occurs. Maps to EMV 3DS field `deviceChannel`.|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|Date and time when the authentication was created in Lithic's system. Permitted values: Date string in the ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh:mm:ssZ.|
|decision_made_by|string \| null|false|none|Entity that made the authentication decision. This won't be set for authentications for which a decision has not yet been made (e.g. in-flight customer decisioning request).|
|merchant|object|true|none|Object containing data about the merchant involved in the e-commerce transaction.|
|message_category|string|true|none|Either PAYMENT_AUTHENTICATION or NON_PAYMENT_AUTHENTICATION. For NON_PAYMENT_AUTHENTICATION, additional_data and transaction fields are not populated.|
|psd2_context|object \| null|false|none|PSD2/SCA context for EEA and UK transactions. Present when Lithic determines the transaction is in scope for PSD2 Strong Customer Authentication. Absent for out-of-scope transactions.|
|three_ds_requestor_challenge_indicator|string|true|none|Indicates whether a challenge is requested for this transaction<br><br>* `NO_PREFERENCE` - No Preference<br>* `NO_CHALLENGE_REQUESTED` - No Challenge Requested<br>* `CHALLENGE_PREFERENCE` - Challenge requested (3DS Requestor preference)<br>* `CHALLENGE_MANDATE` - Challenge requested (Mandate)<br>* `NO_CHALLENGE_RISK_ALREADY_ASSESSED` - No Challenge requested (Transactional risk analysis is already performed)<br>* `DATA_SHARE_ONLY` - No Challenge requested (Data Share Only)<br>* `OTHER` - Other indicators not captured by above. These are rarely used|
|three_ri_request_type|string \| null|false|none|Type of 3DS Requestor Initiated (3RI) request — i.e., a 3DS authentication that takes place at the initiation of the merchant rather than the cardholder. The most common example of this is where a merchant is authenticating before billing for a recurring transaction such as a pay TV subscription or a utility bill. Maps to EMV 3DS field `threeRIInd`.|
|token|string(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier for the 3DS authentication. Permitted values: 36-digit version 4 UUID (including hyphens).|
|transaction|object \| null|false|none|Object containing data about the e-commerce transaction for which the merchant is requesting authentication.|
|updated|string(date-time)|true|none|Date and time when the authentication was last updated in Lithic's system. Equal to `created` until the authentication is updated (e.g. a challenge is completed). Permitted values: Date string in the ISO 8601 format yyyy-MM-dd'T'hh:mm:ssZ.|

#### Enumerated Values

|---|---|

|account_type|DEBIT|

<h2 id="tocS_case-status">case-status</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacase-status"></a>
<a id="schema_case-status"></a>
<a id="tocScase-status"></a>
<a id="tocscase-status"></a>

```json
"OPEN"
```

Status of a case as it progresses through the review workflow:
  - `OPEN` - The case has been created and is still collecting matching transactions
  - `ASSIGNED` - An analyst has been assigned and transaction collection has stopped
  - `IN_REVIEW` - The case is actively being investigated
  - `ESCALATED` - The case has been reviewed and requires additional oversight
  - `RESOLVED` - A determination has been made and a resolution recorded
  - `CLOSED` - The case is finalized

<h2 id="tocS_case-sort-by">case-sort-by</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemacase-sort-by"></a>
<a id="schema_case-sort-by"></a>
<a id="tocScase-sort-by"></a>
<a id="tocscase-sort-by"></a>

```json
"CREATED_ASC"
```

Sort order for listing cases. Defaults to `CREATED_DESC` (newest first):
  - `CREATED_ASC` - Oldest first
  - `CREATED_DESC` - Newest first
  - `PRIORITY_DESC` - Highest priority first
  - `PRIORITY_ASC` - Lowest priority first
  - `STATUS_DESC` - Furthest workflow stage first
  - `STATUS_ASC` - Earliest workflow stage first

|resolution|string \| null|true|none|Outcome recorded when the case was resolved, from the `allowed_resolutions`<br>configured on the case's queue|

|resolved|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date and time at which the case was resolved|
|collection_stopped|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date and time at which transaction collection stopped for the case|

```json
  "title": "string",
  "assignee": "string",
  "resolution": "string",
  "resolution_notes": "string",

    "property2": "string"
  },
  "priority": "LOW",
  "sla_deadline": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "actor_token": "string"
}
```

Parameters for updating a case. All fields are optional; omitted fields are left unchanged.
The nullable fields `title`, `assignee`, and `sla_deadline` can be cleared by sending `null`.

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|status|[case-status](#schemacase-status)|false|none|Status of a case as it progresses through the review workflow:<br>  - `OPEN` - The case has been created and is still collecting matching transactions<br>  - `ASSIGNED` - An analyst has been assigned and transaction collection has stopped<br>  - `IN_REVIEW` - The case is actively being investigated<br>  - `ESCALATED` - The case has been reviewed and requires additional oversight<br>  - `RESOLVED` - A determination has been made and a resolution recorded<br>  - `CLOSED` - The case is finalized<br>|
|title|string \| null|false|none|New title for the case, or `null` to clear it|
|assignee|string \| null|false|none|New assignee for the case, or `null` to unassign|
|resolution|string|false|none|Resolution to record on the case. Must be one of the<br>`allowed_resolutions` configured on the case's queue, otherwise the request is<br>rejected with a `400`|
|resolution_notes|string|false|none|Notes describing the resolution|
|tags|object|false|none|Arbitrary key-value metadata to set on the case|
|priority|[priority](#schemapriority)|false|none|Priority level of a case, controlling queue ordering and SLA urgency|
|sla_deadline|string \| null(date-time)|false|none|New SLA deadline for the case, or `null` to clear it|
|actor_token|string|false|none|Optional client-provided identifier for the actor performing this action,<br>recorded on the resulting activity entry. This value is supplied by the<br>client (for example, your own internal user ID) and is not authenticated<br>by Lithic<br>|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|OPEN|
|status|ASSIGNED|
|status|IN_REVIEW|
|status|ESCALATED|
|status|RESOLVED|
|status|CLOSED|
|priority|LOW|
|priority|MEDIUM|
|priority|HIGH|
|priority|CRITICAL|

```json
"STATUS"
```

The case field that changed, or the action that was taken, in an activity entry:
  - `STATUS` - The case status changed
  - `TITLE` - The case title changed
  - `ASSIGNED_TO` - The case assignee changed
  - `RESOLUTION_OUTCOME` - The resolution outcome was set or changed
  - `RESOLUTION_NOTES` - The resolution notes were set or changed
  - `TAGS` - The case tags changed
  - `PRIORITY` - The case priority changed
  - `COMMENT` - A comment was added or edited
  - `FILE` - A file was attached to the case

  - `PENDING` - An upload URL has been issued and the file is awaiting upload
  - `READY` - The file has been uploaded and validated; a download URL is available
  - `REJECTED` - File validation failed; see `failure_reason` for details

<h2 id="tocS_file">file</h2>
<!-- backwards compatibility -->
<a id="schemafile"></a>
<a id="schema_file"></a>
<a id="tocSfile"></a>
<a id="tocsfile"></a>

```json
{
  "token": "497f6eca-6276-4993-bfeb-53cbbbba6f08",
  "name": "string",
  "mime_type": "string",
  "size_bytes": 0,
  "status": "PENDING",
  "upload_url": "string",
  "upload_url_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "upload_constraints": {
    "accepted_mime_types": [
      "string"
    ],
    "max_size_bytes": 0
  },
  "download_url": "string",
  "download_url_expires": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "failure_reason": "string",
  "created": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z",
  "updated": "1970-01-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

A file attached to a case. Status-dependent fields are always present but may be `null`:
  - `upload_url`, `upload_url_expires`, and `upload_constraints` are populated when `status` is `PENDING` or `REJECTED`
  - `download_url` and `download_url_expires` are populated when `status` is `READY`
  - `failure_reason` is populated when `status` is `REJECTED`

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|token|string(uuid)|true|none|Globally unique identifier for the file|
|name|string|true|none|Name of the file|
|mime_type|string \| null|true|none|MIME type of the file, available once the file is ready|
|size_bytes|integer \| null(int64)|true|none|Size of the file in bytes, available once the file is ready|
|status|[file-status](#schemafile-status)|true|none|Lifecycle status of a case file:<br>  - `PENDING` - An upload URL has been issued and the file is awaiting upload<br>  - `READY` - The file has been uploaded and validated; a download URL is available<br>  - `REJECTED` - File validation failed; see `failure_reason` for details<br>|
|upload_url|string \| null|true|none|Presigned URL the client uses to upload the file|
|upload_url_expires|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date and time at which the upload URL expires|
|upload_constraints|null \| [upload-constraints](#schemaupload-constraints)|true|none|Constraints that the uploaded file must satisfy|
|download_url|string \| null|true|none|Presigned URL the client uses to download the file|
|download_url_expires|string \| null(date-time)|true|none|Date and time at which the download URL expires|
|failure_reason|string \| null|true|none|Reason the file was rejected, when applicable|
|created|string(date-time)|true|none|Date and time at which the file record was created|
|updated|string(date-time)|true|none|Date and time at which the file record was last updated|

#### Enumerated Values

|Property|Value|
|---|---|
|status|PENDING|
|status|READY|
|status|REJECTED|

### Properties

|Name|Type|Required|Restrictions|Description|
|---|---|---|---|---|
|category|string|false|none|Status types:<br>* `TRANSFER` - Internal transfer of funds between financial accounts in your program.<br>|
|created|string(date-time)|false|none|Date and time when the transfer occurred. UTC time zone.|
|currency|string|false|none|3-character alphabetic ISO 4217 code for the settling currency of the transaction.|
|descriptor|string|false|none|A string that provides a description of the transfer; may be useful to display to users.|
|events|[[financial_event](#schemafinancial_event)]|false|none|A list of all financial events that have modified this trasnfer.|
|from_balance|[[balance](#schemabalance)]|false|none|The updated balance of the sending financial account.|
|pending_amount|integer|false|none|Pending amount of the transaction in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents), including any acquirer fees.<br>The value of this field will go to zero over time once the financial transaction is settled.<br>|
|result|string|false|none|APPROVED transactions were successful while DECLINED transactions were declined by user, Lithic, or the network.|
|settled_amount|integer|false|none|Amount of the transaction that has been settled in the currency's smallest unit (e.g., cents).|
|status|string|false|none|Status types:<br>* `DECLINED` - The transfer was declined.<br>* `EXPIRED` - The transfer was held in pending for too long and expired.<br>* `PENDING` - The transfer is pending release from a hold.<br>* `SETTLED` - The transfer is completed.<br>* `VOIDED` - The transfer was reversed before it settled.<br>|
|to_balance|[[balance](#schemabalance)]|false|none|The updated balance of the receiving financial account.|
|token|string(uuid)|false|none|Globally unique identifier for the transfer event.|
|updated|string(date-time)|false|none|Date and time when the financial transaction was last updated. UTC time zone.|

|Property|Value|

|result|APPROVED|
|result|DECLINED|
|status|DECLINED|
|status|EXPIRED|
|status|PENDING|
|status|SETTLED|
|status|VOIDED|
